name: 覃鑫富
objective: This course will teach the fundamentals for packaging, including phase diagrams of solders, bonding technology, metallurgical reactions, and reliabilities, as well as the state-of-the-art Cu-Cu hybrid bonding. It will also cover bonding technology of microelectronic packaging: Die Attach/Chip Bond, Wire Bond, Tape automatic bonding, Flip Chip Technology, Pb-based and Pb-free Solders, Microbumps, 3D IC packaging, Cu-Cu bonding, and Cu hybrid bonding. Metallurgical reactions include Cu-Sn, Ni-Sn, Sn-Au, Ag-Sn, Pd-Sn, and In-Sn. The following reliability issues will be taught: multiple reflow, electromigration, thermomigration, Stress, temperature cycling tests, solid state aging, Sn whisker, and Mean-time-to-failure measurement.
schedule:
The teacher expects each chapter to be finished weekly.
1st Introduction: Phase diagrams, 2nd handout: Chip-level interconnection-Wire bonding
2nd Wire bonding, 
3rd handout: Die attach & Leadframe,
4th TAB; Surface Finishes 
5th Metallurgical Reaction (I) bulk samples
6th Metallurgical Reaction (II) Thin Films & FCT Reliability
7th Pb-based and Pb-free solders, 
8th Metallurgical Reaction (III); 8th Reliability Issues of Pb-free Solder Joints, 
9th Metallurgical Reaction (IV): 9th Cross reactions and massive spalling 
10th Metallurgical Reaction (V): 10th Effect of Solder Volume on Metallurgical 11th reactions and reliabilities of solder joints/microbumps.
12th Electromigration I: EM in Al, Cu and Solder lines
13th Electromigration II: EM in Solder joints; Electromigration III:  Void formation, current and temperature redistribution. 
14th Thermomigration
15th Advanced packaging. EM & TM in microbumps; 
16th 3D IC Packaging; Cu-Cu bonding.
16th 3D IC Packaging; Cu-Cu bonding. 
17th 3D IC Packaging; Cu/SiO2 hybrid bonding. 
18th 3D IC Packaging; Cu/ SiO2 hybrid bonding.
